extra.message: Hardcoded default SECRET_KEY fallback value 'change-me-in-production-local-dev-only' in JWT token signing. If environment variable is not set, this weak secret will be used, allowing attackers to forge authentication tokens.

Hardcoded database credentials in default DATABASE_URL fallback. The connection string contains default username 'postgres' and password 'postgres' which will be used if environment variable is not set.

Path traversal vulnerability in ticket_dropbin_slot_118. User-controlled 'packet_ref' parameter is used directly in file path construction without sanitization, allowing attackers to write files to arbitrary locations (e.g., '../../etc/cron.d/malicious').

Missing authentication on ticket_agent_file_120 endpoint. Unlike other endpoints in this router, this function does not use the gate_ref dependency check, allowing unauthenticated access to internal operational data.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: Open redirect vulnerability in ticket_return_lane_165. The 'lane' parameter is passed directly to RedirectResponse without validation, allowing attackers to redirect users to malicious external sites (e.g., 'https://evil.com').

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site (Open Redirect)

extra.message: Use of cryptographically weak MD5 hash algorithm in ticket_digest_fold_286. MD5 is vulnerable to collision attacks and should not be used for security purposes. Use SHA-256 or stronger instead.

cwe: CWE-916: Use of Password Hash With Insufficient Computational Effort

extra.message: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in ticket_blurb_tile_329. The 'card' parameter is rendered with Jinja2 '|safe' filter, which prevents auto-escaping and allows injection of malicious HTML/JavaScript payloads.

cwe: CWE-80: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page

extra.message: Security misconfiguration in ticket_frame_slip_669. Disables XSS protection (X-XSS-Protection: 0) and clears Content Security Policy, making the application more vulnerable to XSS attacks.

Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability in ticket_jinja_cast_679. User-controlled 'fragment' parameter is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template, allowing remote code execution (e.g., '{{config.__class__.__init__.__globals__['os'].popen('id').read()}}').

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine

extra.message: OS Command Injection vulnerability in ticket_shell_probe_699. User-controlled 'host' parameter is concatenated directly into a shell command executed via os.system(), allowing arbitrary command execution (e.g., host='127.0.0.1; rm -rf /').

Insecure random number generation in ticket_nonce_roll_709. Uses random.choice() instead of cryptographically secure secrets module, making the generated codes predictable and vulnerable to brute force attacks.

cwe: CWE-338: Use of Cryptographically Weak Pseudo-Random Number Generator (PRNG)

extra.message: Path traversal vulnerability in ticket_dock_shelf_726. User-controlled 'name' parameter is used directly in file path construction without sanitization, allowing arbitrary file write to any location on the filesystem.
Insecure SSL/TLS configuration in ticket_trust_drift_729. Uses ssl._create_unverified_context() which disables certificate validation, making the application vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks.

cwe: CWE-599: Missing Validation of OpenSSL Certificate

extra.message: XML External Entity (XXE) vulnerability in ticket_xml_fold_739. The lxml XMLParser is configured with resolve_entities=True and no_network=False, allowing attackers to read local files and perform SSRF attacks via malicious XML payloads.

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: Hardcoded default password 'changeme123' used when creating users during CSV import. All imported users will have the same predictable password, creating a massive security risk if not immediately changed.

Hardcoded demo password 'demo123' used for all seeded user accounts. While this is seed data, if used in production or if production data is accidentally seeded, it creates a critical security vulnerability.
